description: This file defines a data access object (DAO) class EmpUsTaxExemptionDao within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to save and retrieve employee US tax exemption data from the database. It extends a base DAO class and interacts with the EmpUsTaxExemption entity.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Employee US Tax Exemption, providing methods to save and retrieve tax exemption data.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Persists an EmpUsTaxExemption entity to the database and returns the same object.

methods.name: getEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpUsTaxExemption entity based on employee number.
